guides.title: OpenAI Chat Provider · Connection
guides.description: Use Connection in OpenAI Chat Provider.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Open the connection card
steps.body: Enable OpenAI Chat Provider in Addon Manager if needed, then open the Connection area on this provider page. Read the connection card to see what it requires. Use whatever fields the card presents rather than inventing setting names.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Test the connection
steps.body: Once the connection details reflect your intended setup, use Test connection. A passing test shows the endpoint is reachable with the supplied configuration; it does not prove a model produces good replies. If the test fails, re-read the connection card before changing model or generation areas.

guides.title: OpenAI Chat Provider · Model
guides.description: Use Model in OpenAI Chat Provider.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Choose a hosted model
steps.body: The model selector lists models this provider offers. Choose one deliberately and note its name. A hosted provider depends on network access, so a slow or failed first reply can be a connectivity symptom rather than a model fault. Re-test the connection if the selector behaves oddly.

guides.title: OpenAI Chat Provider · Generation
guides.description: Use Generation in OpenAI Chat Provider.
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Read generation options before editing
steps.body: Generation options shape hosted replies. Inspect them in place and change one value at a time. Use a short chat exchange after each change to judge the effect, and avoid attributing odd replies to the model until you have ruled out your own setting changes.
